mn78:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn78:1.3: tena kho pana samayena uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamaṇḍikāputto samayappavādake tindukācīre ekasālake mallikāya ārāme paṭivasati mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ sattamattehi paribbājakasatehi.
mn78:2.1: atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati sāvatthiyā nikkhami divā divassa bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
mn78:2.7: yannūnāhaṃ yena samayappavādako tindukācīro ekasālako mallikāya ārāmo yena uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamaṇḍikāputto tenupasaṅkameyyanti.
mn78:2.8: atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati yena samayappavādako tindukācīro ekasālako mallikāya ārāmo yena uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamaṇḍikāputto tenupasaṅkami.
mn78:3.1: tena kho pana samayena uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamaṇḍikāputto mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ nisinno hoti unnādiniyā uccāsaddamahāsaddāya anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ kathentiyā. seyyathidaṃ:
mn78:3.2: rājakathaṃ corakathaṃ mahāmattakathaṃ senākathaṃ bhayakathaṃ yuddhakathaṃ annakathaṃ pānakathaṃ vatthakathaṃ yānakathaṃ sayanakathaṃ mālākathaṃ gandhakathaṃ ñātikathaṃ gāmakathaṃ nigamakathaṃ nagarakathaṃ janapadakathaṃ itthikathaṃ sūrakathaṃ visikhākathaṃ kumbhaṭṭhānakathaṃ pubbapetakathaṃ nānattakathaṃ lokakkhāyikaṃ samuddakkhāyikaṃ itibhavābhavakathaṃ iti vā.
mn78:3.3: addasā kho uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamaṇḍikāputto pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatiṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
mn78:3.6: ayaṃ samaṇassa gotamassa sāvako āgacchati pañcakaṅgo thapati.
mn78:3.7: yāvatā kho pana samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakā gihī odātavasanā sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasanti, ayaṃ tesaṃ aññataro pañcakaṅgo thapati.
mn78:3.8: appasaddā kho pana te āyasmanto appasaddavinītā appasaddassa vaṇṇavādino,
mn78:3.9: appeva nāma appasaddaṃ parisaṃ viditvā upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññeyyā”ti.
mn78:3.10: atha kho te paribbājakā tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
mn78:4.1: atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati yena uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamaṇḍikāputto tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā uggāhamānena paribbājakena samaṇamaṇḍikāputtena saddhiṃ sammodi.
mn78:4.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatiṃ uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamaṇḍikāputto etadavoca:
mn78:5.1: “catūhi kho ahaṃ thapati, dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññāpemi sampannakusalaṃ paramakusalaṃ uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhaṃ.
mn78:5.3: idha thapati na kāyena pāpakaṃ kammaṃ karoti, na pāpikaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati, na pāpakaṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappeti, na pāpakaṃ ājīvaṃ ājīvati.
mn78:5.4: imehi kho ahaṃ thapati, catūhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññāpemi sampannakusalaṃ paramakusalaṃ uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjha”nti.
mn78:6.1: atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati uggāhamānassa paribbājakassa samaṇamaṇḍikāputtassa bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandi, nappaṭikkosi.
mn78:6.3: bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānissāmīti.
mn78:7.1: atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn78:7.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho pañcakaṅgo thapati yāvatako ahosi uggāhamānena paribbājakena samaṇamaṇḍikāputtena saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo, taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
mn78:8.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatiṃ etadavoca:
mn78:8.2: evaṃ sante kho thapati, daharo kumāro mando uttānaseyyako sampannakusalo bhavissati paramakusalo uttamapattipatto samaṇo ayojjho, yathā uggāhamānassa paribbājakassa samaṇamaṇḍikāputtassa vacanaṃ.
mn78:8.3: daharassa hi thapati, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa kāyotipi na hoti, kuto pana kāyena pāpakaṃ kammaṃ karissati aññatra phanditamattā.
mn78:8.4: daharassa hi thapati kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa vācātipi na hoti. kuto pana pāpikaṃ vācaṃ bhāsissati aññatra roditamattā.
mn78:8.5: daharassa hi thapati, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa saṅkappotipi na hoti, kuto pana pāpikaṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappissati aññatra vikūjitamattā.
mn78:8.6: daharassa hi thapati, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa ājīvo tipi na hoti, kuto pana pāpakaṃ ājīvaṃ ājīvissati, aññatra mātuthaññā.
mn78:8.7: evaṃ sante kho thapati, daharo kumāro mando uttānaseyyako sampannakusalo bhavissati paramakusalo uttamapattipatto samaṇo ayojjho, yathā uggāhamānassa paribbājakassa samaṇamaṇḍikāputtassa vacanaṃ.
mn78:8.8: catūhi kho ahaṃ thapati, dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññāpemi na ceva sampannakusalaṃ na paramakusalaṃ na uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhaṃ. apicimaṃ daharaṃ kumāraṃ mandaṃ uttānaseyyakaṃ samadhigayha tiṭṭhati.
mn78:8.10: idha thapati na kāyena pāpakaṃ kammaṃ karoti, na pāpikaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati, na pāpakaṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappeti. na pāpakaṃ ājīvaṃ ājīvati.
mn78:8.11: imehi kho ahaṃ thapati, catūhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññāpemi na ceva sampannakusalaṃ na paramakusalaṃ na uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhaṃ. apicimaṃ daharaṃ kumāraṃ mandaṃ uttānaseyyakaṃ samadhigayha tiṭṭhati.
mn78:9.1: dasahi kho ahaṃ thapati, dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññāpemi sampannakusalaṃ paramakusalaṃ uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhaṃ.
mn78:9.8: evaṃ paṭipanno akusalānaṃ sīlānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
mn78:9.16: evaṃ paṭipanno kusalānaṃ sīlānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
mn78:9.24: evaṃ paṭipanno akusalānaṃ saṅkappānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
mn78:9.32: evaṃ paṭipanno kusalānaṃ saṅkappānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
mn78:10.2: akusalaṃ kāyakammaṃ, akusalaṃ vacīkammaṃ, pāpako ājīvo.
mn78:10.9: taṃ cittaṃ sarāgaṃ sadosaṃ samohaṃ. ito samuṭṭhānā akusalā sīlā.
mn78:10.10: ime ca thapati, akusalasīlā kuhiṃ aparisesā nirujjhanti.
mn78:10.12: idha thapati, bhikkhu kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveti, vacīduccaritaṃ pahāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāveti, manoduccaritaṃ pahāya mano sucaritaṃ bhāveti. micchāājīvaṃ pahāya sammāājīvena jīvikaṃ kappeti,
mn78:10.14: kathaṃ paṭipanno ca thapati akusalānaṃ sīlānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti:
mn78:10.15: idha thapati bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati,
mn78:10.16: uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati,
mn78:10.17: anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
mn78:10.18: uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
mn78:10.19: evaṃ paṭipanno kho thapati, akusalānaṃ sīlānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
mn78:11.2: kusalaṃ kāyakammaṃ, kusalaṃ vacīkammaṃ. ājīvaparisuddhipi kho ahaṃ thapati, sīlasmiṃ vadāmi.
mn78:11.9: yaṃ cittaṃ vītarāgaṃ vītadosaṃ vītamohaṃ, ito samuṭṭhānā kusalā sīlā.
mn78:11.10: ime ca thapati, kusalasīlā kuhiṃ aparisesā nirujjhanti:
mn78:11.12: idha thapati, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti no ca sīlamayo,
mn78:11.13: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. yatthassa te kusalasīlā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
mn78:11.14: kathaṃ paṭipanno ca thapati kusalānaṃ sīlānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti:
mn78:11.15: idha thapati bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati,
mn78:11.18: uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā. asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
mn78:11.19: evaṃ paṭipanno kho thapati, kusalānaṃ sīlānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
mn78:12.11: ime ca thapati, akusalasaṅkappā kuhiṃ aparisesā nirujjhanti:
mn78:12.13: idha thapati bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
mn78:12.15: kathaṃ paṭipanno ca thapati, akusalānaṃ saṅkappānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti:
mn78:12.16: idha thapati, bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati,
mn78:12.19: uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
mn78:12.20: evaṃ paṭipanno kho thapati, akusalānaṃ saṅkappānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
mn78:13.11: ime ca thapati, kusalasaṅkappā kuhiṃ aparisesā nirujjhanti:
mn78:13.13: idha thapati, bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
mn78:13.15: kathaṃ paṭipanno ca thapati kusalānaṃ saṅkappānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti:
mn78:13.16: idha thapati, bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati,
mn78:13.19: uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
mn78:13.20: evaṃ paṭipanno kho thapati, kusalānaṃ saṅkappānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
mn78:14.1: katamehi cāhaṃ thapati, dasahi dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññāpemi sampannakusalaṃ paramakusalaṃ uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhaṃ:
mn78:14.2: idha thapati, bhikkhu asekhāya sammādiṭṭhiyā samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammāsaṅkappena samannāgato hoti, asekhāya sammāvācāya samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammākammantena samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammāājīvena samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammāvāyāmena samannāgato hoti, asekhāya sammāsatiyā samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammāsamādhinā samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammāñāṇena samannāgato hoti, asekhāya sammāvimuttiyā samannāgato hoti.
mn78:14.3: imehi kho ahaṃ thapati, dasahi dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññāpemi sampannakusalaṃ paramakusalaṃ uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhanti.
mn78:14.5: attamano pañcakaṅgo thapati bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
